title: On Critical Dimensions for Compactness in the Boundary Yamabe Problem, II
summary: We determine the sharp compactness ranges for the scalar-flat and minimal-boundary Yamabe problems on smooth compact manifolds of positive conformal type, excluding the conformal round hemisphere. For zero scalar curvature and positive constant boundary mean curvature, compactness holds through dimension $14$ for general boundary and dimension $21$ for umbilic boundary. For positive scalar curvature and zero boundary mean curvature, the corresponding upper dimensions are $14$ and $20$.
